annotations.title: Look up an IP or domain

description: Look up an IP address or a domain against the ThreatCrush community threat database (what every linked ThreatCrush daemon blocked). Returns `listed` (the corroboration bar: independent reporters agree), a 0-100 `score`, severity, reports, reporters, rules and country; a domain is answered from its A/AAAA addresses plus nichedb.dev's public answer (abuse.ch, SURBL). With Reputation Pro: 90 days of history, the /24 neighbourhood, the network owner (ASN) and how much of it is listed, city and the reasons behind the score. Registered servers, allowlisted addresses and anyone who logged in are never reported.
